page.overview:
Who is Violet Moody?

Violet Moody is one of few Maisie Lockwood's friends, they met at the campsite run by the former's grandparents, during the time when Claire, Owen and Maisie kept a low profile after the events at Lockwood Manor.

At age 12, Maisie and her parents went to a campsite called "Happy Trail" where they would spend three weeks while remaining fugitives. Maisie and her parents were taking a walk by the blue lake in the area, she met a group of kids her age who were coming out of the forest towards the lake, among this group was Violet, who is revealed to be the granddaughter of the administrators. of the campsite. After talking a little, Maisie shows Violet her drawings of dinosaurs, feeling impressed by the detail these portraits had compared to what dinosaurs looked like in real life. A little later, Violet heads into the forest, Maisie follows her encountering a pair of Triceratops, Tri and Pi. Violet reveals that she and her friends had recently found these dinosaurs and were trying to help them get to Fenders Rock so they wouldn't run the risk of being hunted.

Violet and Maisie spent more time together, talking about finding a way to help Tri and Pi.

One day, Owen and Claire go to a meeting so Maisie stays with Violet and her grandmother, there the blonde reveals that her parents died when she was little and that is why she lived with her grandparents. They discover two poachers, Jones and Macnally, who were looking to hunt Blue and other dinosaurs. After a series of problems, Maisie discovers that her parents cannot return in time, so Violet, Maisie and their friends decide to make a plan to save the Triceratops and stop the hunters. Using water balloons and other traps, the hunters are outwitted by Violet, Maisie and their friends. However, Violet is caught by Jones, who threatens her to find out where the animals were. Blue intervenes and causes the defeat of Jones, the raptor watches Violet with unknown intentions, Maisie saves her friend and manages to place a tracker on Blue so that she can be located another time.
